title: The Smoothbore Primer
summary: Teaches the shouldered stance, the level shot and the butt-plate shove to first-year recruits with no qi.

title: A Handbook of Loading and Ramming
summary: Sets out the cartridge, powder, patch and ramrod sequence step by step for recruits who must load under pressure.

title: Stance and Shouldering for the Long Gun
summary: Builds the shoulder, the hold and the steady breath that let a muscled recruit keep a heavy musket level.

title: The Bayonet Recruit's Workbook
summary: Drills the socket bayonet thrust, parry and butt strike for recruits whose tendons can bear the long lunge.

title: Care and Carrying of the Musket
summary: Teaches carrying, guarding and clearing a fouled musket on the march, for recruits at the bone stage.

title: Elementary Priming and Firing Drill
summary: Teaches a first qi-steadied firing drill to students who have only just begun to circulate their own qi.

title: A Drill-Book of the Firing Line
summary: Trains students to fire, reload and hold their place in rank, using a thread of qi to steady the hands.

title: Principles of the Aimed Shot
summary: Sets out sighting, breath and trigger release for single aimed shots, with a little qi held in the arms.

title: Breath and Barrel: A Workbook
summary: Links the breath cycle to a steady barrel, so a student learns to fire in the pause between heartbeats.

title: The Musket Guard Manual
summary: Covers sentry, picket and escort handling of the musket, with the bayonet kept ready beside the shot.

title: A Primer of Steady Fire Under Smoke
summary: Teaches students to keep loading and firing in thick powder smoke and noise without losing their line.
